context_requirements: Cells must be actively proliferating and dependent on microtubule dynamics for mitotic spindle function.
Intact or permissive mitotic checkpoint signaling to allow G2/M accumulation.
Functional apoptotic machinery for late apoptotic gene induction.
p53 status modulates the transcriptional response; p53-deficient lines may show weaker CDKN1A induction but can still arrest and die.
falsifiers: No accumulation of mitotic markers such as CCNB1, BIRC5, PLK1, or AURKB at 6 h or 24 h.
No decrease in proliferation-associated genes such as CCNA2, MCM3, or PCNA at 24 h.
No evidence of G2/M arrest or apoptosis-associated gene changes at 24 h.
Transcriptional responses indistinguishable from vehicle across all nine cell lines.

evidence.supports: Microtubule destabilization blocks cell cycle transition specifically at G2-M phase.
Microtubule inhibitors cause prolonged cyclin B1/Cdc2 activity and apoptosis; p21 status modulates sensitivity.
Microtubule inhibitor treatment causes G2/M accumulation and upregulation of cyclin B1.
Microtubule inhibitors block cells in G2/M by acting on microtubule dynamics.
